pr.description:
Unified PR lifecycle CLI — creation, CI failures, code review, and review comments

When to use: Managing PR lifecycle: opening a PR, checking CI status, running reviews, addressing comments, or viewing unified PR status. Across many open PRs at once (rebase, fix CI, comments, self-review): `pr batch run --checkout DIR`; `pr batch report` prints per-PR session commands; see `pr batch run --help`

Usage: pr create [--draft] [--no-verify] [--dry-run] [--base <branch>] [--title <text>] [--body <text> | --body-file <path>] [--issue <id>] [--closes <id>] [--skip-review <reason>]  |  pr status  |  pr ci [--run <id>] [--fix] [--post] [--wait] [--wait-timeout <sec>] [--wait-interval <sec>] [--head-sha <head-sha>] [--no-rebase] [--no-verify]  |  pr review [--no-post] [--submit] [--self] [--fix] [--track <finding-id>] [--push] [--skip-user-verification] [--force] [--no-holistic] [--no-scout] [--no-group] [--no-synthesis] [--no-disprove] [--disprove] [--json-summary] [--issue <url>] [--focus remote_effects.how: unless --no-rebase, and only when the branch is behind origin/main: rebase.commands.cmd_start(..., RunMode.FIX) — the same force-push as pr rebase --fix, git push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/<branch>:<expect> (docs/ai-automation.md#pr-rebase-contract). Then git.land.land -> git.push.push of the fix commit (plain, never forced), gated by --post via core.publishing.enabled().
remote_effects.on_refusal: A paused conflicted rebase skips the fix pass (exit 1). A refused, failed, or aborted rebase continues the fix pass on the current base. A refused or held push leaves the fix commit local (not exit 1 unless the commit itself failed).
remote_effects.writes: a rebase force-push of refs/heads/<branch> (as pr rebase --fix) when behind and not --no-rebase, then the fix commit pushed to refs/heads/<branch>

remote_effects.how: skips the verify gate (an agent exercising each claimed fix against the tree); every fix lands unverified; not git's pre-push hook
remote_effects.on_refusal: n/a — the flag does not write remotely
remote_effects.writes: nothing extra: changes how --fix lands locally

remote_effects.how: REST via pr.comments._gh_post -> gh.client.api (thread replies, issue-comment summary, PR body PATCH); GraphQL via pr.comments.resolve_thread -> gh.client.graphql (resolutions). A --track/--track-all tracking issue at --finish is review.issue.create_issue (GitHub through gh.client; Linear through the linear CLI). Gated by core.publishing.enabled().
remote_effects.on_refusal: a failed write is reported per thread (resolve_verified_threads and reply drains continue); nothing already posted is rolled back
remote_effects.writes: thread replies, thread resolutions, the round summary comment, and (with --track/--track-all at --finish) the tracking issue

remote_effects.how: review.closeout.push_held_commit -> git.push.push(gated=True), plain, never forced; args=('--no-verify',) when --no-push-verify. unpublished_commit runs that before any GitHub write; then the --post GitHub writes.
remote_effects.on_refusal: the summary is not posted (run_threads returns 1). git.push.report prints Resume on REFUSED/LOST; a HELD push prints none. PushBlock.message names pr push --expect then pr comments --finish --post
remote_effects.writes: a held fix commit pushed to refs/heads/<branch>

remote_effects.how: fix.engine._land -> git.land.land(gated=True) -> git.push.push, plain, never forced. A publishing hold (pr.triage_round.hold_after_verify / TriagedRound) drafts the push; --finish --post is what lands a held commit.
remote_effects.on_refusal: a refused or held push leaves the commit local (not exit 1 unless the commit itself failed); --finish --post lands a held one
remote_effects.writes: the fix commit pushed to refs/heads/<branch> when publishing is still enabled; a hold (discussion still open) leaves it local for --finish --post

Then gh pr create --title … --body-file - --assignee @me --base <base> [--draft].
remote_effects.on_refusal: a refused push stops before any AI call or PR; git.push.report prints the Resume line. A refused gh pr create leaves the branch already on origin.

remote_effects.how: forwards --post to the review binary as --self --fix --post (not the pr review --post mode; same land as --self --fix --push in docs/ai-automation.md#pr-review-contract): git.land.land(gated=True) -> git.push.push, plain. Then pr ci --fix --post (docs/ai-automation.md#pr-ci-contract). Then pr describe --post (docs/ai-automation.md#pr-describe-contract). The comments pass is never run; a hint says to run pr comments --fix.
remote_effects.on_refusal: a refused or held push leaves that pass's commit local; a failed describe leaves earlier writes in place. Review exit 4 (superseded) stops before CI and describe.
remote_effects.writes: the review fix commit, the CI fix, then the PR description

remote_effects.how: git push [--no-verify] --force-with-lease=refs/heads/<branch>:<lease>, where <lease> is the tip origin holds now (read with ls-remote) when it is --expect or an ancestor of --expect (a fast-forward); when origin cannot be asked, --expect itself. Records PushDomain in state.json, no rebase.
remote_effects.on_refusal: origin at neither --expect nor an ancestor of it: refused before pushing (stale --expect), exit 1. origin has no such branch: exit 1 — pr push never creates a branch. origin moves between the read and the push: stale info, nothing written, exit 1.
remote_effects.writes: refs/heads/<branch> := HEAD

remote_effects.how: git push [--no-verify] --force-with-lease=refs/heads/<branch>:<expect>, where <expect> is origin/<branch> as this checkout saw it before the run's own fetch (empty when origin has no such branch, which creates it). The git pre-push hook runs unless --no-verify; the workbench owner check (gh.owner_hooks.refuse_outgoing) runs either way.
remote_effects.on_refusal: origin moved since the lease was taken: git reports stale info, nothing is written, exit 1. Resume line: git ls-remote origin refs/heads/<branch>. A refused pre-push hook leaves the rebase complete and unpushed (JSON force_pushed false).
remote_effects.writes: refs/heads/<branch> := the rebased HEAD

remote_effects.how: git push [--no-verify] --force-with-lease=refs/heads/<branch>:<expect> (same lease as the bare invocation)
remote_effects.on_refusal: origin moved since the lease was taken: git reports stale info, nothing is written, exit 1. Resume line: git ls-remote origin refs/heads/<branch>.
remote_effects.writes: the same push, after AI conflict resolution

remote_effects.how: git push [--no-verify] --force-with-lease=refs/heads/<branch>:<expect>, where <expect> is RebaseSummary.lease_expect that the last completed rebase saved in the target's state.json
remote_effects.on_refusal: No recorded rebase: exit 1. A recorded empty lease while origin has the branch: exit 1 ('recorded lease is stale'). origin moved since the lease was taken: git reports stale info, nothing is written, exit 1. Resume line: git ls-remote origin refs/heads/<branch>.
remote_effects.writes: refs/heads/<branch> := current HEAD, commits added since the rebase included; no rebase runs

remote_effects.how: git push [--no-verify] --force-with-lease=refs/heads/<branch>:<expect>, where <expect> is exactly the SHA given (use the full SHA); no recorded rebase is needed
remote_effects.on_refusal: origin moved since the lease was taken: git reports stale info, nothing is written, exit 1. Resume line: git ls-remote origin refs/heads/<branch>.
remote_effects.writes: refs/heads/<branch> := current HEAD; no rebase runs

remote_effects.how: adds --no-verify to git push, skipping the git pre-push hook; the owner check still runs. For a hook failure already understood — a flake, or a check the branch did not cause
remote_effects.on_refusal: as for the push it modifies
remote_effects.writes: nothing extra: changes how the push above runs

remote_effects.how: review.publish.resolve prompts unless --no-post (or the review binary's --post, which pr review does not reach); then review.publish.post -> cli.review_post -> review.posting.post_review, a PENDING review with inline comments. --submit then review.publish.submit_pending as a COMMENT review. A self-review files no GitHub review (review.run.run_self_review).
remote_effects.on_refusal: declining a prompt leaves the review on disk, unposted; a failed post is not rolled back
remote_effects.writes: a PENDING review with inline comments; --submit submits it as a COMMENT review

remote_effects.how: review.invoke.run forwards --post to orchestrate when may_publish (--push or the binary's --post). fix.engine._land -> git.land.land(gated=True) -> git.push.push, plain, never forced.
remote_effects.on_refusal: a refused or held push leaves the commit local; git.push.report prints Resume on REFUSED/LOST, nothing on HELD
remote_effects.writes: the fix commit pushed to refs/heads/<branch>

remote_effects.how: cli.review_modes.post -> core.publishing.call_entry_point(cli.review_post:main). --event picks comment/approve/request_changes; approve and request_changes imply --submit.
remote_effects.on_refusal: no PR number or no review file: exit 1, GitHub unchanged; a failed post is not rolled back
remote_effects.writes: posts an existing review; --event picks comment/approve/request_changes

remote_effects.how: review.file_tracked.run -> review.finding_issue.file_and_link -> review.issue.create_issue (GitHub through gh.client; Linear through the linear CLI), gated by core.publishing.enabled(). Under pr review, --post is a mode and cannot combine with --track; the publishing spelling is review --self --track ID --post.
remote_effects.on_refusal: without the publishing gate the filing is drafted; a failed create leaves the findings unfiled
remote_effects.writes: files the finding on the tracker (GitHub or Linear issue)
